id: c987dd45-74b9-5550-b970-a8fc919d0ec6
status: experimental
description: |
    Detects exploitation attempts related to CVE-2020-5902 (Web Application).
    Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v166.2.
    Severity: CRITICAL | Class: PATHTRAVERSAL
references:

tags:

detection:
    selection:
        EventID:
            - 4625
            - 4648
            - 4728
        LogonType: 3
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative access
    - Service account activity

kql_query:
// SENTINEL APEX — CVE-2020-5902 — Anomalous Activity Detection
// Product: Web Application | Generated: 2026-08-22T01:14:04Z
let lookback = 1d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID in (4625, 4648, 4728, 4740, 4776)
| summarize FailureCount = count(), DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetUserName)
    by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailureCount > 10 or DistinctTargets > 5
| extend Severity = "MEDIUM", CVE = "CVE-2020-5902", RuleSource = "SENTINEL-APEX"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
suricata_rule: alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HTTP_SERVERS $HTTP_PORTS (msg:"SENTINEL-APEX CVE-2020-5902 Exploitation Attempt - PATHTRAVERSAL"; flow:established,to_server; content:"|90 90 90 90|"; rawbytes; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 3, seconds 60; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:8174864; rev:1; metadata:created_at 2026-08-22, source SENTINEL-APEX-v166.2;)
